title: Someone just dropped a tool on GitHub that writes scripts, edits videos, does voiceovers, and…
description:
Someone just dropped a tool on GitHub that writes scripts, edits videos, does voiceovers, and generates video. Full-on content creation on autopilot. Craziest part? It's completely free. You just describe the video you want. The system writes the script, generates the video, adds the voiceover, and hands you a fully edited clip.

#ai #github #opensource #aitools #texttovideo #aivideo #automation #contentcreation
